newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 1.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Oct. 1:
ABOARD VALUJET FLIGHT 6 - ValuJet Airlines resumes service after a three-month hiatus ordered by the FAA following the May 11 crash of one of its aircraft.
WASHINGTON - Janitors in the nation's capital seek higher pay in contract negotiations between their union and the District of Columbia.
WASHINGTON - AT&T begins sending out 525 million shares of stock in Lucent Technologies to its shareholders.
WASHINGTON - The Washington law firm of Nussbaum & Wald has been dissolved by its founding partner after a dispute over compensation.
